decisions_this_run: D-070i: supersedes() answers only 'is the incoming release newer?'. Equal versions are left to the store's own transition check so the two failures stay distinguishable.
D-070j: the guard lives in the domain, not only the use case - it is an invariant of the version numbering, and the domain check remains the backstop for callers that bypass the use case.
D-070k: refusal surfaces as Conflict (409), not a 422 - the caller is in conflict with current state, not malformed.

APPROVE_AGENT_ACTION is a distinct OrgPermission rather than a reuse of MANAGE_ORGANIZATION, so a role can co-sign a sensitive agent action without being able to reshape the organization. ORG_SECURITY_ADMIN/ORG_AUDITOR stay read-only, preserving the separation of duties the matrix was built for.

Second-signer authority is scoped to a shared operational tenant rather than to any org admin globally: an approver must share an active organization with the agent's owner, so authority cannot reach agents outside their tenant.

head_drift_policy: `commit` names the last head whose *product* code was verified by CI, not necessarily the branch tip. NEXUS checkpoint updates are themselves docs-only commits, so the tip advances one commit past `commit` every time this file is written - chasing it is an unbounded loop (run 64 hit this: 7456a89 -> 974d03f -> c49befe, each fix creating a new tip). On reconciliation, compare the product tree, not the SHA: `git diff <commit>..HEAD -- src/ tests/` being empty means `commit` is still an accurate description of what CI verified.
commit_note: A checkpoint commit cannot name itself. 787ed57 is the last substantive commit; every later commit on this branch is a docs-only checkpoint that descends from it, so its CI still compiles and tests the same product code. To find the live head, poll `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/feature/agentic-enterprise-platform` rather than trusting this field. Each such docs commit also cancels the previous head's in-flight CI (branch concurrency), so `conclusion: cancelled` means superseded, never failed.
